description: The Avaya G350 Media Gateway is a powerful convergednetworking device that packs an IP telephony gateway, an advanced IP WANrouter, and a high-performance LAN switch into a compact (3U) modularchassis. In addition, the G350 is a VPN IP-SEC based gateway, ideal forbranch offices deployments that require an integrated solution for advanceddata and Voice over IP applications. Designed to be a complete voice/datanetworking solution, the G350 Gateway is well suited for enterprises withdistributed branch office locations using 8-40 extensions.
